title: CreeperShield
description: Prevent creeper spawns near players with permission.
body:
[![AshCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a75887d69106ed9eb2dd595176121f279523f184_0.webp)](https://www.ashcraft.cz/)

The CreeperShield plugin is designed to prevent creepers from spawning near specific players on a Minecraft server. By granting players a designated permission, server administrators can selectively shield certain areas or players from the nuisance and potential damage caused by creepers. This plugin is especially useful for protecting key zones or players during events, in creative mode, or in high-risk areas. [Here is a comprehensive explanation of its features and functionality.](https://ashsource.ashkiano.com/resource-detail/38)
